description: This file is a React component that displays a list of recipes, supports search functionality, and allows users to favorite or unfavorite recipes. It fetches data from an API, manages local state, and renders a UI with navigation and search capabilities.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches recipes based on the search query and updates the component state.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Handles search input, updates query state, and triggers data reload.

methods.name: onToggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a recipe by calling the appropriate API functions and updating local state.
